regel: Add 1 if the attack vector is network.
Add 1 if no authentication is required.
Add 1 if more than 10 systems are affected.
Level 1 = low, level 2 = medium, level 3 = high, level 4 = critical.

faelle.beschreibung: An attacker on the internet can forge a session token for the credential vault. No login is needed. 14 servers run the affected release.
A logged in employee can read wiki pages of other departments over the corporate network. 6 systems host the wiki.
A user who is already logged in to a machine can read the backup agent configuration file with the stored share password. 4 machines are affected.
An unauthenticated request to the internet facing VPN gateway returns the firmware version and the list of configured user groups. 3 gateways are affected.
A device in the same network segment can send a print job that runs a driver installer without any login. 25 print servers are affected.
An authenticated employee can change the bank account of another employee over the network. The portal serves 40 application servers.
Anyone with physical access to a console can restart the monitoring agent without logging in. 18 hosts run the agent.
A developer with an existing shell account can overwrite the build script of another project. 9 build servers are affected.
An unauthenticated sender on the internet can relay mail through the gateway and spoof internal addresses. 30 relays are affected.
A user in the same wireless network who knows the room PIN can change the calendar of a conference room. 7 tablets are affected.
